answer: The defence rests on neighbourhood watch coordinator tenure with patrol logs: patrols coordinated for one street for years. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Forging 107 of these means building 107 separate patrol logs from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. A mesa marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the sparrow ledger turns 107 aliases into 107 bills while the mirror path for the honest stays a single payment.
